diagnosis.root_cause: The subscriber's CATV service is provisioned and enabled, but the ONU reports catv_synced=0, so the television RF signal is not locking. Internet service and the EPON/data path are healthy.
evidence: The complaint is limited to TV channels; Internet traffic is active and stable.
The ONU is online with normal RX power of -20.4 dBm and TX power of 2.45 dBm.
Seven-day optical telemetry is stable: RX remains around -20.4 dBm, TX around 2.3 dBm, bias current remains healthy, and distance is constant at 118.
All visible peers on EPON0/7 are online and healthy, so there is no shared ONU, splitter, PON-port, or OLT outage.
The OLT responds to ping, SNMP, and subtree queries, and its CPU, memory, and temperature are normal.
The router heartbeat is healthy and the subscriber has normal authenticated sessions with long durations.
RADIUS exists, matches CRM, and the expected customer VLAN 1037 is present and correctly assigned; VLAN 46 is not being used.
The subscriber has CATV enabled and has_catv=1, but catv_synced=0, directly indicating loss of CATV lock.
The evidence therefore points to a CATV RF/optical alignment or receiver problem affecting this customer only.

remediation.action: Check CATV optical/RF levels at the subscriber outlet and ONU, inspect or reseat the coaxial and fibre connectors, verify the CATV wavelength and RF configuration, and test or replace the ONU CATV receiver if levels are normal. Recheck CATV synchronization and channel acquisition after repair.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
